text:
jamal: FYI ap-southeast1-b started spiking GPU preempts ~04:18 UTC. Saw 10-15% of GPU pods preempted in last 15m, concentrated on two racks. Nodes show conntrack table full errors and short NotReady flaps.
mira: damn. kubelet eviction reason? logs?
jamal: paste: ```kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
kubelet: eviction manager: nodefs.available below threshold -> reclaiming resources
iptables: conntrack entries 65536/65536```
alex: link to grafana?
jamal: https://grafana.internal/d/conntrack/ap-southeast1-b -> conntrack_count jumps then eviction spikes. also noticed many small S3 multipart clients opening sockets.
mira: I bumped nf_conntrack_max to 200k on a canary node and requeued a job; evictions stopped on that node. cmd used: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000`
ops-bot: action: canary/sysctl-bump by mira at 04:42 UTC :white_check_mark:
sre-lead: good quick fix. options: (1) cluster-wide nf_conntrack_max bump in node bootstrap, (2) lower conntrack timeouts for CLOSE_WAIT/ESTABLISHED, (3) tune app keepalives to reduce ephemeral churn, (4) add scheduler preempt cushion to avoid immediate preempts during network noise.
mira: agree on multi-pronged approach. lowering nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_close_wait to 30s helped in dev. `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_close_wait=30`
alex: on scheduler side we can prototype a small reserved fraction per rack (5%) so eviction aggressiveness reduces: pseudo-flag `--scheduling-reserve-per-rack=0.05`. could canary this.
jamal: note cost/impact: bumping nf_conntrack_max increases kernel memory ~6-9MB per node at 200k entries. across ~380 GPU nodes that's ~2.5-3.4GB extra. mention to finance.
sre-lead: action items: mira -> PR for node-init sysctl bump gated to GPU pools (ETA 2h). alex -> prototype scheduler reserve flag in ap-southeast1-b (ETA 3h). jamal -> collect pcap + offending job IDs and sample client IPs (ETA 1h). monitor node_mem and conntrack metrics.
mira: starting PR, will gate by node label `gpu=true`. rolling canary on rack-7 now.
alex: will mock scheduler flag in test cluster then deploy a canary to that region.
jamal: if cushion works we can avoid cluster-wide kernel changes in other regions. will update in 30m.
